name: Katiz Xemir's homeworld
description: The Human Katiz Xemir settled on a remote colony planet and called it home. However, after Xemir refused to relocate offworld to make way for a mining facility on the planet, the Galactic Empire killed his family. That caused Xemir to hire himself out as a mercenary against Imperial targets.
